scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: The exact maximumRequestBytes limit is computed from a matching project context, compile prompt, empty-corpus text, indexed-context JSON, and fixed request overhead. That ceiling dispatches scripted ACP and reaches the injected receipt-bound compile-valid validator. The one-byte-lower control asserts the exact computed required-byte diagnostic, zero dispatches/validation, unchanged source/head/node count, one retained RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED run, no pending attempt, and empty retained corpus. The same execution covers existing exact/one-over raw diagnostic characters and retained regression input bytes, count, and argument count.
